name: application-table-empty-state
title: Table Empty State
description: Full-width empty state embedded inside a real table (header row intact, a single spanning row underneath) with an illustration, message, and an add-first-row call to action.
useWhen: A data table has zero rows and you want the empty state to appear inside the table's own structure, columns still visible.
You want a clear next action ("New project") directly where the first row would otherwise appear.
The table's column headers are worth keeping visible even with no data, so users still see the schema.
avoidWhen: The empty state should replace the whole view, not sit inside a table — use `empty-states` for a full-page zero-data screen instead.
The table is loading, not empty — use `Table Loading Skeleton` so users don't mistake pending data for a genuinely empty table.
A fetch actually failed — use `Table Error State` with a retry action rather than presenting a failure as if there's simply no data.
responsiveBehavior: Table wrapper scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via its containing overflow rather than compressing columns; the spanning empty-state row stays centered and readable at any table width.
accessibility: The empty-state content lives in a real <td colSpan> spanning every column, so screen readers reading the table still get a single, coherent cell rather than fragmented column-by-column content.
Column headers remain in the DOM and visible even with zero data rows, so the table's structure is still announced.
The illustration is aria-hidden since the adjacent heading and description already state the empty condition in text.

variants.title: Table Empty State
variants.description: Name/Owner/Status/Last updated header with a spanning "No projects yet" panel and a New project CTA.
accessibility: colSpan is driven by the actual column count, so it never under- or over-spans if columns are added or removed.

variants.title: Table Empty State (Dark)
variants.description: Table empty state adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Illustration and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
